title: A long term name wraps onto a second line and is never cut off
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} has a 31-character name, due 14 days after the invoice date, and is the default for new customers.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-20 Long Name 0123 (31 characters).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Look at the {Term-A} row's Name cell, with the browser window at its narrowest desktop width (for example 1280 pixels).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the whole name shows, every character, wrapping onto a second line if it does not fit; no "..." and no cut-off letters. The "Default" tag comes after the end of the name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R15: “Term names are never cut off in the table; a long name wraps onto a second line, with its icons and "Default" tag after it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("A 31-character term name"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.
